_source: JDE Peet's Annual Report 2025 (jde-peets-annual-report-2025.pdf, 58.7 MB, dl 2026-05-20 from jdepeets.com)
_note: JDE Peet's : largest pure-play coffee & tea company globally. Brands : Jacobs, L'OR, Peet's Coffee, Senseo, Tassimo, Douwe Egberts. 21000+ employees, 39 facilities, 24 countries.

kpis.explanation_fr: Plus grand segment JDE Peet's : Europe = 51.6% des ventes. Couvre In-Home (cafe pods/instant) + Out-of-Home (machines/services aux entreprises).
kpis.explanation_en: JDE Peet's largest segment: Europe = 51.6% of sales. Covers In-Home (coffee pods/instant) + Out-of-Home (machines/services to businesses).
kpis.signal: Europe +8.4% YoY (organic +20.6% mostly price-driven, +0.4% volume). Adjusted EBIT Europe 993M EUR (vs 1041M en 2024) = pression marge intense par cout cafe vert.

kpis.explanation_fr: Segment LARMEA = Latin America (notamment Bresil top market), Russia, Middle East, Africa. Plus fort taux de croissance JDE 2025.
kpis.explanation_en: LARMEA = Latin America (Brazil top market), Russia, Middle East, Africa. JDE's fastest-growing segment 2025.
kpis.signal: LARMEA explose +29.9% YoY. Driver = Bresil ~14% du CA total Groupe. Adjusted EBIT LARMEA 321M EUR (+44%).

kpis.explanation_fr: EBIT ajuste = KPI profitabilite cardinal JDE Peet's. 2025 = 1295M EUR (+1.4% vs 2024). Pression marge intense (cafe vert +50% YoY).
kpis.explanation_en: Adjusted EBIT = JDE Peet's cardinal profitability KPI. 2025 = 1295M EUR (+1.4% vs 2024). Intense margin pressure (green coffee +50% YoY).
kpis.signal: Adj EBIT margin 13.1% (vs 14.5% 2024). Pression marge confirmee par inflation 1.6 Mds EUR sur intrants 2025.
kpis._specific_to: JDE Peet's margin sensitivity to coffee prices
kpis.source: JDE Peet's Annual Report 2025 p.10, p.197

kpis.explanation_fr: Cash flow disponible JDE Peet's. 1130M EUR en 2025. Permet desendettement 611M EUR de net debt.
kpis.explanation_en: JDE Peet's available cash flow. 1130M EUR in 2025. Enables EUR 611M net debt reduction.
kpis.signal: FCF excellent grace a working capital management. Net leverage 2.5x (vs 2.9x debut 2025).

kpis.explanation_fr: Nombre de tasses de cafe JDE Peet's servies par les consommateurs dans le monde. KPI unique de penetration consommation.
kpis.explanation_en: Number of JDE Peet's coffee cups served by consumers globally. Unique consumption-penetration KPI.
kpis.signal: 122 milliards tasses/an. Vraie metrique d'impact, single-year disclosure.
kpis.source: JDE Peet's Annual Report 2025 p.10 (What we deliver)

kpis.explanation_fr: Bresil est devenu le 1er marche JDE Peet's (14% du CA, +3pts vs 2024). Marche cafe domestique critique.
kpis.explanation_en: Brazil is now JDE Peet's #1 market (14% of revenue, +3pts vs 2024). Critical domestic coffee market.
kpis.signal: Bresil passe devant USA (12%) et France (12%) en 2025. Acceleration LARMEA franchise.

kpis.explanation_fr: % du cafe vert achete repondant aux Coffee Responsible Sourcing Principles. KPI ESG cardinal JDE.
kpis.explanation_en: % of green coffee purchased meeting Coffee Responsible Sourcing Principles. JDE cardinal ESG KPI.
kpis.signal: 100% responsibly sourced en Europe atteint. 88.8% globalement.
